event: Singapore's independence. Life expectancy ~65 years. Infectious diseases dominant.
Singapore General Hospital opens its new campus.
Medisave launched — compulsory medical savings scheme.
First National Health Survey conducted — baseline chronic disease data established.
WHO ranks Singapore 6th globally for health systems.
Chronic Disease Management Programme (CDMP) launched for diabetes, hypertension, hyperlipidaemia.
National Health Survey reveals sharp rise in diabetes (11.3%) and obesity (10.8%).
PM Lee declares 'War on Diabetes' at National Day Rally.
Singapore achieves world's highest life expectancy at 84.8 years.
COVID-19 pandemic. Life expectancy dips. Health expenditure surges to $13.9B.
Healthier SG White Paper published — shift towards preventive care and enrolment with family doctors.
Healthier SG programme officially launches. Screen for Life enhanced.
